name: 対象の範囲を選ぶ写真パネル
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit ORIGINAL input1 for Lighthouse component LH01-0068 対象の範囲を選ぶ写真パネル. Input2 is Japanese mock for translation only; original controls exact photo, crop, proportions, all fine geometry. Keep original tall component extent and photo aspect, no device/status/bottom toolbar.
Treat original photograph as immutable pixels: preserve exact silver oval tray, purple checked flowers, long green stem, hand/fingers, black clothing/shoes, rug pattern and cream curtains. Preserve all existing gray dimming masks, dashed irregular object selection boundary, rectangular dashed boundary and two rounded crop handles. Do not reconstruct, smooth, sharpen, move, enlarge, alter crop or regenerate any photo detail.
Preserve original top left X, disabled curved-arrow undo and redo glyphs in their exact form/positions; keep undo/redo light gray. Do NOT replace glyphs with words from the mock. Change only the existing upper-right Done button text to Japanese "完了" in Meiryo Regular400 14/24-equivalent, tracking0. Change this existing primary pill fill to restrained forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E and its label white. Existing X utility glyph slate#526173. Purewhite #FFFFFF external surface. Keep clean compact hierarchy and original button geometry.
No added title, helper text, new controls, redesigned crop outlines or styling of the image. The only edited regions should be Done button and X glyph color. Photo fidelity is essential; this is localized UI-overlay editing, not a new photograph. Output one crisp flat frontal component raster. Interaction and image-selection behavior remain unverified.
reviewNotes: Japanese Done pill and original X/undo/redo/selection structure restored, but protected photo texture, floral detail and framing were resynthesized; label heavier than Regular. Source pixel fidelity unresolved; raster candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
